args.request: Add the recovered Midnight Club 3 DUB Edition Remix files to both the source catalog and the dealership. Preserve existing assets/metadata and independent working-copy ownership. The recovered files are native PS2 DAT/PCK packages: catalog/download them honestly with explicit unavailable previews while geometry conversion remains unresolved. Add native game/variant filtering to the existing server-side TypeSafe Choice/Noul/Score behavior. Do not fabricate GLBs, retail names, statistics or a playable roster. Verify corrupt-input controls, UI cleanup, real catalog preservation and actual checks. This diff is scoped to the current catalog follow-up; the prior native extractor and independent preview-readiness note are separately reviewed.
claims: The source viewer selects MC3 native packages without reading them as GLBs, clears prior geometry and exposes the native DAT download with unavailable-preview status and disabled model controls.
The actual source-viewer callbacks and native UI checks pass, including returning to a GLB after native selection.
